Author: Mayo Botic
Name: AutoRezzer
Description:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
